posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Being Ronway is like being the friend that everybody hates, but for some reason they never want to actually kick the friend out of the group. I find it quite enjoyable that people who have joined the G+ games have asked about the hate against Ronway, it's even more fun when I am there when they ask about it. I've been tempted to disappear for awhile just to see how long the Ronway things carry on in my absence, but I am so hooked on reading all the post here that I am unable to bring myself to do such a thing.

I'm Ronway all the time! My family loves it. Ronway has become a family name! Our last Router was named Ronway. The Maplestory character you see in my avatar is RonnieRonway, who would team up with my father, who went by the name of DaddyRonway. I just hope my son will carry on the Ronway name into the internet!

I am Ronway and I have no intention of being anything else! You folks are stuck with me!
